parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 2000, system: "You extract job postings from the text of a careers page. Return ONLY a JSON array, no markdown fencing, no commentary. Each element: {"title": "", "location": "", "description": "", "url": ""}. Use an empty string when a value is not stated on the page — never invent one. If the page lists no open roles, return [].", messages: [ { role: "user", content: "COMPANY: " + $json.company + "
PAGE URL: " + $json.url + "
PAGE TEXT:
" + $json.page_text } ] } }}

={{ { model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 300, system: "You score how well a candidate fits a job posting, 0-100. Return ONLY compact JSON like {"score": 82, "reason": "one sentence"}. No markdown fencing, no extra text.", messages: [ { role: "user", content: "CANDIDATE PROFILE:
" + $('Config').first().json.candidate_profile + "

JOB TITLE: " + $json.title + "
COMPANY: " + $json.company + "
JOB DESCRIPTION:
" + ($json.description || "").slice(0, 4000) } ] } }}

={{ { model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 500, system: "You write cover letters. Direct, specific, no corporate filler. 200 words max. Never invent experience not in the candidate profile.", messages: [ { role: "user", content: "<candidate_profile>" + $('Config').first().json.candidate_profile + "</candidate_profile>
<job_description>" + ($json.description || "").slice(0, 4000) + "</job_description>
<company>" + $json.company + "</company>

Extract the 3 requirements this employer clearly cares most about.
Map each to specific evidence from the candidate profile.
If a requirement has no honest match, do not address it.
Output only the letter body." } ] } }}
